bioAdditions: Leo served in the US Army during the Korean War and then spent 34 years with IBM, retiring as a finance controller. Around 1954 he married Jean D. Rossi of Old Forge, and they were married 65 years. He died at home in Exton on 1 July 2019, aged 90; his funeral Mass was said at St. Elizabeth Church, Chester Springs, and he was buried privately in Scranton (S1, S2). His obituary notes that he was predeceased by five brothers and a sister, confirming the eight Cognetti children (S1).
